description:
About the job

Link to Apply:

https://heva.co/hiring/apply




Company Description

heva is an AI practice management platform for doctors serving medical tourists. Founded by product and technical leaders from Apple, Google, Stryker, and Harvard, heva is scaling quickly and eager to grow its team.




We are backed by top tier investors, including Flybridge Capital, Benchstrength, Collide Capital, Spice Capital, Bharat Biotech, and The MBA Fund.




Join us to reshape the future of global healthcare.




Role Description

heva is the operating system for cross-border care, connecting U.S. and international patients with vetted clinics across Latin America.




As an Appointment Setter based in Mexico City, you'll sit at the top of our B2B sales funnel — filling the Account Management team's calendar with prequalified clinic and doctor meetings through both outbound cold outreach and fast response to inbound leads. This is a high-activity, phone-first role for someone who is rejection-proof, learns fast, and treats every script and tactic as something to test and improve rather than something to guess at.




Responsibilities

Cold-call clinics and doctors in target markets, prequalifying each prospect on fit — the right vertical (plastics, bariatrics, dental, or IVF), international-patient appetite, patient volume, decision-maker access, and tech readiness — and book discovery or demo calls for the Account Management team.
Respond quickly to inbound leads from campaigns, the website, Instagram, WhatsApp, and referrals, qualify them, and get them booked.
Disposition every call and log it to the Notion CRM in real time, keeping the pipeline clean and up to date.
Hit daily activity targets and weekly booked-meeting quotas, and protect show rate through confirmations and reminders.
Bring proven outbound or dialer calling experience with a track record of successfully setting appointments.
Maintain a strong phone presence, staying resilient and high-activity through rejection and high call volume.
Practice strong CRM discipline with clean, consistent call-disposition habits.
Bring healthcare, medical-tourism, or B2B SaaS calling experience, which is a plus.
Bring fluency with Apollo.io or similar prospecting tools, which is a plus.




Qualifications

Rejection-proof phone presence — cold dials, gatekeepers, and hang-ups don't rattle you, and you pick up the next call without hesitation.
Coachable and quick to learn — you take feedback without ego and get to competence quickly in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.
You treat scripts, flows, and tactics as testable, proposing variants, measuring results, and iterating on what wins instead of guessing.
Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete playbooks — biased to action, shipping, learning, and improving rather than waiting for perfect instructions.
Bilingual in English and Spanish, business-fluent in both directions, for U.S. patients and LATAM clinics.
Comfortable working across WhatsApp, Instagram, web, email, and phone as everyday channels. 
Understands heva as a full cross-border healthcare operating system (AI chat, U.S. patient financing, CRM, deposits, intake, pre/post-op) rather than a chatbot or CRM tool.




What we'll measure:

Dials per day and connect rate.
Qualified appointments set per week.
Show rate and appointment-to-opportunity conversion — quality, not just volume.

Acerca de nosotros 

Somos Movizzon una empresa de tecnología especializada en monitoreo sintético de canales digitales. description:
About the job

Oportunidad profesional en Inteligencia Artificial

Estamos en búsqueda de Ingenieros y/o especialistas en Inteligencia Artificial con mentalidad innovadora y pasión por construir soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos. Esta persona participará en el diseño e implementación de sistemas inteligentes que aprovechen modelos de lenguaje de última generación, Python y el ecosistema de Google Cloud Platform.




El rol está enfocado en el desarrollo de agentes inteligentes y arquitecturas basadas en Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) para resolver desafíos complejos y habilitar nuevas capacidades tecnológicas dentro de la organización.




Principales funciones

Desarrollo de agentes inteligentes

Construir soluciones autónomas basadas en modelos de lenguaje avanzados (familia Gemini u otros), capaces de automatizar procesos y mejorar la interacción con usuarios y sistemas.

Implementación de soluciones en la nube (GCP)

Diseñar, desplegar y operar aplicaciones de IA utilizando servicios como Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions y Kubernetes Engine.

Arquitecturas RAG

Diseñar pipelines que integren modelos de lenguaje con fuentes de conocimiento internas para generar respuestas contextualizadas, precisas y confiables.

Programación en Python

Desarrollar soluciones robustas utilizando herramientas del ecosistema de ciencia de datos y machine learning (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch o TensorFlow).

Optimización de prompts y evaluación de modelos

Diseñar estrategias de prompt engineering y métricas de evaluación que permitan mejorar el desempeño y confiabilidad de los modelos en entornos productivos.

Trabajo colaborativo con equipos multidisciplinarios

Convertir necesidades del negocio en soluciones técnicas y comunicar resultados de forma clara, mostrando el impacto en procesos y decisiones.




Perfil profesional

✔ 2 a 3 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o AI Engineering.

✔ Dominio sólido de Python y librerías de análisis y aprendizaje automático.

✔ Experiencia trabajando con Google Cloud Platform, especialmente en servicios de IA y analítica.

✔ Formación en Ingeniería, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, Estadística o carreras afines.

✔ Conocimiento en LLMs, NLP, embeddings y arquitecturas modernas de modelos de lenguaje.




Se valorará adicionalmente

Experiencia práctica implementando arquitecturas RAG
Conocimiento de frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de agentes
Experiencia trabajando con Docker y Kubernetes
Manejo de bases de datos SQL y NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
Estudios de posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial o áreas relacionadas

About the job

Link to Apply:

https://heva.co/hiring/apply




Company Description

heva is an AI practice management platform for doctors serving medical tourists. Founded by product and technical leaders from Apple, Google, Stryker, and Harvard, heva is scaling quickly and eager to grow its team.




We are backed by top tier investors, including Flybridge Capital, Benchstrength, Collide Capital, Spice Capital, Bharat Biotech, and The MBA Fund.




Join us to reshape the future of global healthcare.




Role Description

heva is the operating system for cross-border care, connecting U.S. and international patients with vetted clinics across Latin America.




As an Appointment Setter based in Mexico City, you'll sit at the top of our B2B sales funnel — filling the Account Management team's calendar with prequalified clinic and doctor meetings through both outbound cold outreach and fast response to inbound leads. This is a high-activity, phone-first role for someone who is rejection-proof, learns fast, and treats every script and tactic as something to test and improve rather than something to guess at.

Practice strong CRM discipline with clean, consistent call-disposition habits.
Bring healthcare, medical-tourism, or B2B SaaS calling experience, which is a plus.
Bring fluency with Apollo.io or similar prospecting tools, which is a plus.




Qualifications

Rejection-proof phone presence — cold dials, gatekeepers, and hang-ups don't rattle you, and you pick up the next call without hesitation.
Coachable and quick to learn — you take feedback without ego and get to competence quickly in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.
You treat scripts, flows, and tactics as testable, proposing variants, measuring results, and iterating on what wins instead of guessing.

Dials per day and connect rate.
Qualified appointments set per week.
Show rate and appointment-to-opportunity conversion — quality, not just volume.
